text: In 5 of 5 analysed books framed by bedtime or sleep the last spread is quieter than the book's average (0-1 of 5 against 2.1-3.1); in non-bedtime books this holds for 8 of 17, and many end on a joyful payoff at or above the average. None of the 21 books has a celebration after the story: they close with a picture, a vignette or credits. Evidence: 5 of 5 works, small sample, confidence LOW. Proposal for `reader.page_turn`: In bedtime mode only: let the last story page stand alone as a quiet moment (no auto-advance, narration ends softly), and make the ending leaf calm: no celebration animation and no reading counts on that screen; keep today's ending for adventure and learning.
